description: Upcoming election dates (primary, general, runoff) for one state (name or two-letter code), from the races PowerPlayers tracks, each with the number of races on that date and an example race. localElections lists city, town and county elections where an official source names the date, each with its source link (pass place, a Census place GEOID, to narrow it to one place); it can be empty. Not an official calendar: confirm with the election office (get_voter_registration_info has the official links).
name: get_election_dates
title: Get upcoming election dates
